event.title: Shirley Dixon's 90th Birthday
event.subtitle: A celebration to remember
event.summary: Shirley Dixon's 90th birthday was celebrated on 25 July 2026 at Karbeethong Lodge in Mallacoota, with about 70 family members and friends gathering for an afternoon of food, music, photographs and good company by the water.

venue.name: Karbeethong Lodge
venue.fullAddress: 16 Schnapper Point Drive, Mallacoota VIC 3892, Australia
venue.description: A welcoming waterfront lodge in Mallacoota — an ideal setting for family celebrations and group gatherings.
venue.caseStudy: Karbeethong Lodge gave the celebration space to gather, share food and enjoy Mallacoota's waterfront setting. Guests could stay on site, and the lodge felt personal rather than formal — well suited to a multi-generation family milestone.
